title: MAS-Guard: Unified Guardrails from Individual Agents to Multi-Agent LLM Systems
title_zh: MAS-Guard提出统一防护框架，通过本地护栏与系统级控制平面相结合，显著降低单智能体及多智能体LLM系统的攻击成功率。【模型发布】

paragraphs.en: 总结： Agentic AI extends large language models (LLMs) from generating responses to planning and executing complex workflows, substantially expanding their utility while exposing applications to unsafe actions, information leakage, and adversarial manipulation. Multi-agent systems further expand these capabilities through specialization and collaboration, but distributed authority, heterogeneous roles, and opaque or potentially compromised participants make safeguarding even more challenging. Existing defenses address important individual threats but provide fragmented coverage across local execution, system-level interactions, and enforcement mechanisms. We introduce MAS-Guard, a unified framework that closes this gap for safeguarding single- and multi-agent AI applications containing both instrumentable and opaque agents. Within instrumentable agents, the proposed local Agent Guardrail (A-Guard) layer applies task-specific experts to assess agentic events. At the system level, developer-owned Agent Charters and a Control Plane combine deterministic structural checks of routes, agent capabilities, and message formats with semantic assessments of roles and message content. These complementary layers enable enforcement through a shared set of interventions: allow, reflection, confirmation, and block. Evaluated across six benchmarks covering diverse single- and multi-agent scenarios with three agent LLMs from different providers, MAS-Guard reduces the overall attack success rate by 71.5-86.3% relative to unguarded agents, while meeting the utility reference criterion on benign tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：智能体式人工智能（Agentic AI）将大语言模型（LLMs）从生成响应扩展到规划和执行复杂工作流，在大幅提升其效用的同时，也使应用面临不安全行为、信息泄露和对抗性操纵的风险。 多智能体系统通过专业化分工与协作进一步拓展了这些能力，但权限分散、角色异构以及参与者不透明或可能已被攻破，使得安全防护更加困难。 现有防御措施能够应对某些重要的个别威胁，但在本地执行、系统级交互和执行机制等方面提供的覆盖是碎片化的。 我们提出 MAS-Guard，这是一个统一框架，为包含可插桩智能体和不透明智能体的单智能体与多智能体人工智能应用填补了这一安全防护空白。 在可插桩智能体内部，所提出的本地智能体防护栏（A-Guard）层运用特定任务的专家模型来评估智能体事件。 在系统层面，由开发者掌控的智能体章程（Agent Charters）与控制平面相结合，将对路由、智能体能力和消息格式的确定性结构校验，与对角色和消息内容的语义评估相结合。 这些互补的层级通过一组共享的干预手段实现管控：允许、反思、确认和阻止。 在覆盖多样单智能体与多智能体场景、并使用来自不同提供商的三个智能体大语言模型的六个基准上进行评估后，MAS-Guard 相对于无防护的智能体将总体攻击成功率降低了 71.5%–86.3%，同时在良性任务上满足效用参考标准。
